text:
jonah: Planning a short pen-test window next Tue 16:00 PT. Need quick signoffs: RBAC temp roles, KMS unwrap proxy, audit exports, and retest slots. Can we do a dry-run Monday?
sarah: I’ll own RBAC. Proposing 'pt-session' role: read-only, Deny:ConfigChange, 3h max, MFA required, session tag pt_id.
kevin: I'll build a proxy lambda for decrypts. Assessor uses signed JWT -> proxy -> KMS. Proxy logs subject and request id. Avoid giving assessors direct decrypt.
elaine: For audit, stream CloudWatch -> Kinesis -> S3 prefix pt-evidence/ with versioning. Short-term exports 14d, snapshots 90d.
maria: Triage board updated: https://phab.redwood/pt-intake. Please add repro steps and severity. Attach evidence links there only.
assessor-bot: Intake bucket created s3://redwood-pt-intake. Uploads via presigned URLs only (1h expiry).
jonah: Quick checklist for retest acceptance: PR linked, triage card updated with proof-of-fix, smoke tests pass in staging, and logs show only proxy unwraps.
sam: I'll cover oncall for the window. Need another SRE for rollback standby.
kevin: KMS note: key policy should require kms:RequestPrincipalTag/pt_id and reject unlabeled requests. Also bind EncryptionContext pt_id.
sarah: Also enforce session tagging and deny role if tag missing.
elaine: Will enable additional CloudTrail selectors for the window and debug logging on proxy.
maria: Tagging: severity, exploit-path, rollback-id, pt-session. Makes retest clear.
assessor-bot: Reserved Tue 16:00 slot. Please upload fixes 24h before retest.
jonah: Final owners: RBAC = sarah; KMS/proxy = kevin; Audit = elaine; Triage = maria; Oncall = sam. Sending invites. :thumbsup:
